change_under_test: A second training venue, Diglett's Cave, with navigation from Cinnabar: Dig or Fly to Vermilion, the Vermilion nurse, VERMILION_CENTER_TO_ROUTE_11, the Route 11 gate walk, and into the cave. None of it has met the emulator.

assumed_party.source: what the previous run produced at the Mansion block

computed_selection.why: The escort at 55 is at the floor and excluded. The level-20 member can engage the whole of a 15-21 band and none of a 28-34 one, so the cave is the only venue that suits it, and it is the weakest member with anywhere to go.

predicted.outcome: the run reaches the venue-travel path and fails inside it
predicted.reasoning: Standing in Cinnabar with the cave selected, `is_in_map` is false, so heal_and_return runs as the travel mechanism. That immediately enters the unvalidated Fly. The town-map cursor is driven by six hand-derived hops with ten-frame waits, and neither the hop count nor the wait length has been checked against the game.
predicted.most_likely_failure: 'Fly to Vermilion failed. Map: <id>, position: <x, y>' — the cursor lands on the wrong town, or the ten-frame waits are too short for the moves to register
predicted.confidence: low on the specific failure, high that it fails somewhere in travel rather than reaching the cave

what_would_refute_this: It reaches Diglett's Cave and fights there — the Fly chain is right and the remaining work is smaller than assumed
It fails before the Fly, in Dig — the problem is the departure, not the town map
It flies somewhere other than Vermilion and continues anyway — the arrival check is not binding, which would be worse than failing
It selects the Mansion rather than the cave — the venue-selection computation above is wrong about what the loop does
also_changed: The cave venue now takes its band from MEASURED_TRAINING_VENUES instead of restating it. The numbers were identical, so this changes no behaviour; it puts the band under the drift guard, which a hand-copied duplicate had escaped.
cost_note: Previous runs reached this point in roughly five to six minutes.
